content: Tauri 2 WS options: (a) webview JS WebSocket - dies when window closed, no tray-only mode; (b) Rust tokio-tungstenite in core + app_handle.emit('event', payload) to frontend listen() - survives window close, reconnect logic in Rust, works with tray; (c) official tauri-plugin-websocket - Rust client exposed to JS API (but tied to webview lifecycle calls). For tray-resident daemon: (b) is correct; connection lives in Rust, UI is optional consumer.
